Name: Decorative Chests - Bog Style
Author: glitchcrow
Description:
As someone who hoards way too many items I always end up with a ton of chests, and rather then try and hide them so they don't mess up my decorating I thought it would be cool to try and incorporate them instead.

This mod features a bunch of different items all themed for a witchy style, with some indoor and some outdoor styles that you can use to turn your chests into decorations on the farm. There's also a few different colour options for many of them so you can mix and match to your hearts content

The pack covers all types of chests, including Junimo, so you don't have to worry about redoing your decorating when you upgrade your chests

This is hopefully the first of a series of themed mods for turning chests into decor items.

Huge thank you to everyone in Bogwyytch's discord for being extremely supportive! As well as Bog for letting me use their assets
